description:
Your Pharaoh plan and mapped repos in each workspace. Changes nothing.

CALL THIS WHEN:
• Checking which plan a workspace is on
• A tool says the plan doesn't include it, or a repo isn't mapped
• Finding the setup page or the billing page

RETURNS: Each workspace you can access with its plan and tracked-repo count, whether its repos are mapped on every push, the setup page, and the billing page when a workspace has a billing account.

action.description: Only status; pharaoh_manage_repo re-maps a repo

name: pharaoh_account
title: Account Status
